description: This file defines an interface named ActionSummary within the OrangeHRM Dashboard module. It specifies method signatures for retrieving a group's ID, name, and pending action count, serving as a contract for classes that implement it.
external_methods: interface method signatures: getGroupId(), getGroup(), getPendingActionCount()

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the action group as an integer.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the name of the action group as a string.

methods.name: getPendingActionCount
methods.description: Returns the count of pending actions as an integer.
